answer: Spot-audit lottery stops fakes. Each identity locks 70 credits, files a jade-sealed voyage log. Each epoch a lottery draws 5%; a drawn identity has one hour to file a fresh echo from one leg of its voyage. The auditor recomputes the echo; a rented echo, copied log, or missed hour burns the bond. Filing: 38 first, 6 more per later one; 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked vs a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 38 once and keeps its bond.
